description: Source of random gates: each row of knobs picks between two voltages on a clock pulse and falls back to a third while the clock is low, with a rare extra pulse of its own

params.text: One of the two voltages the top output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about a third of the time, despite the panel printing 66 per cent over it
One of the two voltages the top output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about two thirds of the time, despite the panel printing 33 per cent over it
The voltage the top output falls to while the clock is low; in the Pool mode it becomes a third value the output can be latched to instead
Steps through Pool, Bar and Disco: Bar moves each row on one clock in three, Disco on 90, 69 and 42 per cent, and Pool latches a random one of a row's three knobs at 99, 75 and 40 per cent
One of the two voltages the middle output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about a third of the time, despite the panel printing 66 per cent over it
One of the two voltages the middle output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about two thirds of the time, despite the panel printing 33 per cent over it
The voltage the middle output falls to while the clock is low; in the Pool mode it becomes a third value the output can be latched to instead
Sets the span of the three CV outputs: 0 to 8V on Uni, and -8V to +8V on Bi
One of the two voltages the bottom output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about a third of the time, despite the panel printing 66 per cent over it
One of the two voltages the bottom output takes on a clock pulse, chosen about two thirds of the time, despite the panel printing 33 per cent over it
The voltage the bottom output falls to while the clock is low; in the Pool mode it becomes a third value the output can be latched to instead

inputs.text: A voltage above 1V is the clock; the three CV outputs take a new value on its rising edge and drop to their floor voltages while it is low
A rising edge above 1V returns the random sequence to where it started, so the same run of values comes round again
A rising edge above 1V moves the module on to a different random sequence, which the reset input then loops

outputs.text: Carries the value picked from the top row of knobs, and that row's floor voltage while the clock is low
Carries the value picked from the middle row of knobs, and that row's floor voltage while the clock is low
A 5V pulse on about two clock pulses in every hundred
Carries the value picked from the bottom row of knobs, and that row's floor voltage while the clock is low; the maker's tooltip names it 1A or 2B where the panel prints 1A or 1B

notes: every knob comes up at its lowest position, so all three CV outputs read 0V until the knobs are moved
the lamp beside each CV output glows green for a positive voltage and red for a negative one
